name: type
label: Document type
help: Document type to calculate the price for. For example, `credit-note`.

name: data
label: File
help: File content mapped from a previous module, for example Gmail or Google Drive.

name: fileName
label: File name
help: File name with extension. For example, `invoice.pdf`.

name: linesOcr
label: Read lines with OCR
help: Includes OCR line-item extraction in the quote when **Document type** is `invoice`. Sends `X-Parser-Lines: ocr`.

name: force
label: Force fresh read
help: Calculates the price for a fresh read instead of a cached result. Sends `X-Parser-Force: 1`. Getting a quote spends no credits.
